run_selfplay_dialog: run a self-play dialogue between Alice and Bob agents using loaded model files and a context generator
get_agent_type: get the appropriate agent class type for a given model and smart mode flag
create_selfplay_instance: create a SelfPlay instance with a dialog, context generator, arguments, and optional logger
run_main_cli: run the selfplay script via CLI with arguments for model files, context, temperature, and domain
load_and_configure_agents: load Alice and Bob models from files and configure them with smart or diverse agent types
